metadata.title: Soul Revival Double Exposure Album Art

retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s soul aesthetic featuring a double-exposure portrait of a female artist in a sequined dress paired with psychedelic, interlocking custom lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition centered on a double-exposure photograph of a woman in a shimmering sequined dress, flanked by large, stylized psychedelic lettering on the left and a structured tracklist on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking letterforms overlapping the subject's shoulder
Double exposure transparency blending two poses of the same figure
Warm gradient text fill contrasting with the cool-toned studio background
Right-aligned secondary typography balancing the heavy display type on the left
coreInvariants: Sequined or reflective texture on the subject's clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, featuring a full-body seated pose overlaid with a larger bust-up portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, custom-lettered artist name in the upper-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold lettering on the left, moves to the subject's face, then follows the dress down to the right-aligned tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Muted, neutral studio background providing high contrast for the sequined texture.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purples and oranges in the text gradient
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Shimmering white and silver from the sequins
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation background allows the high-saturation text gradients and high-value sequin highlights to pop.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth-tone gradients for text

letterConstructionRules: Interlocking strokes where characters share boundaries
Exaggerated swashes and terminals that curl into negative space
Thick, uniform outlines with internal color gradients
characterSpecificRedesigns: M and N with elongated, curving legs
B and R with overlapping loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, fluid custom display type paired with a structured, high-contrast classical serif for legibility.

preserve: Interlocking nature of the display text
avoid: Drop shadows on the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s serif flair for secondary text
Matches the fluid, interlocking skeleton of the main title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a double-exposure photograph of a woman in a shimmering sequined dress against a neutral studio backdrop, blending a seated full-body pose with a larger bust-up portrait.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom interlocking psychedelic lettering in the top-left with an orange-to-purple gradient and thin black outline. Add a right-aligned tracklist in a red serif font in the top-right.

verificationChecks: Is the double exposure clearly visible?
Do the letters in the main title interlock or touch?
Is the dress texture shimmering and sequined?

adjustableVariables: Color palette of the text gradient
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the lettering does not look like a standard font.
Ensure the double exposure doesn't muddy the subject's face.
Verify the gradient direction in the text is consistent.
Confirm the sequin texture is prominent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Double Exposure Portrait + Interlocking Psychedelic Lettering + Sequined Texture + Neutral Studio Backdrop
